cxx_sources_note: the sources unity_copter.cpp includes, each compiled as its own translation unit with the reference flags, and what they reference out of line (AP_Common/Location.cpp, AP_Param/AP_ParamT.cpp)

world.cxx_world_note: the C++ side defines the four objects as unity_copter.cpp does, the motors as ardupilot/ap_motors_driver.h's DriverMotors (AP_MotorsMatrix with the --boundary-call members rc_write, rc_write_angle, rc_set_freq recording the call instead of reaching the HAL, as the translation makes them Output events); the library sources are compiled unmodified, each as its own translation unit (cxx_sources, as check_unity.py checks the unity file against)
globals: extern AP_AHRS oracle_ahrs;          // ardupilot/copter_env.cpp: the AHRS stub (AP::ahrs()), under the view cpp2lean_ahrs_view
static bool cpp2lean_armed_flag;   // AP_Notify::flags.armed after the last call

inputs.pos_control.get_relative_position_D_orig: (void)(%s);   // not read: get_relative_position_NED_origin returns true (the stub)

world.input_aliases_note: one C++ value read by several World objects: AP_HAL::millis() (the slew limiters of the rate PIDs and of the vertical acceleration PID, the position controller, the navigator), the view's yaw (attitude and position controllers), the AHRS stub's vertical velocity (get_vert_pos_rate_D returns sample.vel_ned.z, as get_velocity_NED), and AP_Param::configured() (both PWM range parameters ask the same storage)
world.const_inputs_note: what the stubs return: no digital outputs or boost-throttle channel, no output channel masks (copter_env.cpp); every AHRS estimate valid, gain scalers 1, no EKF resets (ardupilot/stubs/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h)
world.input_corners_note: corner values of each input of a World object for the member functions of that object that read its inputs
world.domains_note: index arguments the C++ does not range-check (values outside [0, AP_MOTORS_MAX_NUM_MOTORS) read or write outside the arrays), MOT_PWM_MIN/MAX (negative values make output_to_pwm and set_throttle_passthrough_for_esc_calibration convert a negative float to uint16_t), and actuator values outside [0, 1] for output_to_pwm (int16_t overflow): undefined behavior in the C++. armed, interlock and the desired spool state are held at the flying values (armed, interlocked, THROTTLE_UNLIMITED) in these two runs; the run `spool` drives them freely
after_call: if (AP_Notify::flags.armed != cpp2lean_armed_flag) { cpp2lean_armed_flag = AP_Notify::flags.armed; cpp2lean_ev("AP_Notify_flags_armed"); cpp2lean_ev_b(cpp2lean_armed_flag); }

motors.update_throttle_range: cpp2lean_ev("set_esc_scaling"); cpp2lean_ev_u(hal.rcout->_esc_pwm_min); cpp2lean_ev_u(hal.rcout->_esc_pwm_max);   // RCOutput::set_esc_scaling (non-virtual inline, RCOutput.h:153) is the last call of update_throttle_range, its only caller

world_runs.run_note: the code defaults of all four objects; the motors armed, interlocked, THROTTLE_UNLIMITED (the old AP_Motors/AC_Attitude/AC_PosControl/AC_WPNav defaults runs)

world_runs.params_note: sim/params/copter-cf2x-tuned.txt (ATC_INPUT_TC, ATC_ACC_R_MAX, ATC_ACC_P_MAX, ATC_ANG_RLL_P, ATC_ANG_PIT_P) and SITL's ATC_RAT_YAW_P 0.3, ATC_RAT_YAW_I 0.02 (copter.parm); sim/params/copter-cf2x-tuned.txt: PSC_NE_POS_P, PSC_NE_VEL_P, PSC_NE_VEL_D

world_runs.run_note: WP_SPD 1, WP_ACC 1.5, weighted to update_wpnav, the position controller's time step (which the navigator reads) up to 0.1 s, so that legs are flown to their end
